//BugTrapBlueprint: A recipe for CardData/Item/hw_bugtrap.json (plan section 19), VANILLA CARDS ONLY. The plan asked for ONE blueprint whose slot takes Cold Resin or Cold Tar, but a BlueprintElement has no alternatives list: the only way to accept two cards in one slot is a CardTabGroup, and no vanilla group holds both (GpTag_Sealant holds only the HEATED resin and tar, and shipping a CardTabGroup JSON is forbidden), so there is one blueprint per material producing the same trap. This one takes Cold Resin (fb5584f7cdb4ead47938ef3c74355b0b). Registered through HarshWilds/BlueprintTabs.json under vanilla Survival > Support (TabName.LocalizationKey Tab_1_Survival_Subtab_2_Support_TabName, read from the export's CardTabGroup/Tab_1_Survival_Subtab_2_Support.json). Researchable from the start: StartUnlocked false with empty CardsOnBoard, TagsOnBoard and StatValues; BlueprintUnlockTicksCost 4; one stage, BuildingDaytimeCost 2 (the cap is 12). One Cold Resin makes one trap; the quantity is a TUNABLE PLACEHOLDER.

CardDescription.DefaultText: Smear a stick with cold resin and set it down in camp: biting insects stick to it, so there are fewer of them for about a day, then it is spent.
